description: Sheriff Bryan Linder of Franklin Parish, Sheriff Chad Ezell of Madison Parish, and Sheriff Rob Rushing of Tensas Parish have endorsed Misti Cordell for Congress, saying she will stand with local law enforcement and prioritize public safety for families across the district.
